_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits mid-band with no ETF/CVD impulse breaker; coil base rate favors HOLD while adjacent Complacency is the only legal +1 rung if drift continues without a flush or FOMO spike.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both non-aggressive near-term, but analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency vs narrative price-up-with-distribution caution; no shared LONG or SHORT
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 45-55, 30d momentum stays mid-band, and ETF flows remain non-impulsive
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks <39 or >63, or sustained ETF-flow/CVD impulse drives momentum out of the mid band
